channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 45,6% contra 34,1% de Haddad em SP
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas leads the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 45.6% voting intentions in the first round, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey conducted June 16–18, 2026. Fernando Haddad follows with 34.1%, and in a hypothetical runoff, Tarcísio extends his lead to 51.4%. Haddad also records the highest rejection rate among pre-candidates at 42.5%.

item.title: Haddad é rejeitado por 42,5% dos eleitores em SP
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey shows Fernando Haddad has the highest rejection rate among São Paulo gubernatorial pre-candidates, with 42.5% of voters saying they would never vote for him. Incumbent governor Tarcísio de Freitas leads voting intentions in both rounds, with 45.6% in the first round and 51.4% in the runoff, compared to Haddad’s 34.1% in the first round. Conducted between June 16–18, 2026, with 1,600 respondents, the poll has a 2.5-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Marina e Tebet lideram disputa ao Senado em SP
item.description: Marina Silva and Simone Tebet lead the Senate race in São Paulo with 35.1% and 32.4% voting intentions, respectively, within the 2.5-point margin of error, making them technically tied. Marina is also the most rejected candidate, with 28.6% of respondents saying they would not vote for her. The survey, conducted by Paraná Pesquisas from June 16–18, 2026, interviewed 1,600 voters across 80 municipalities and is registered with the TSE under SP-08639/2026.

item.title: Vantagem de Tarcísio sobre Haddad diminui em nova pesquisa para o governo de São Paulo
item.description: The Paraná Pesquisas institute's survey released this Friday (19) shows that Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos)'s lead over Fernando Haddad (PT) in the São Paulo gubernatorial race has narrowed from 13.8 to 11.5 percentage points since May. Although the change falls within the 2.5-point margin of error, Tarcísio maintains leads of 45.6% in the first round and 51.4% in the second, compared to Haddad's 34.1% and 37.9%. His advantage has been gradually declining since February, when he led by over 23 points.

item.title: 55,3% dos paulistas apostam em reeleição de Tarcísio
item.description: A Paraná Pesquisas survey shows 55.3% of São Paulo voters believe Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) will be re-elected in October 2026, while 29.1% expect Fernando Haddad (PT) to win. In voting intentions, Tarcísio leads with 45.6% in the first round and 51.4% in a potential runoff against Haddad, who has 34.1%. Conducted June 16–18, 2026 with 1,600 respondents across 80 municipalities, the poll has a 2.5-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Governo comemora acordo entre EUA e Irã
item.description: The Brazilian government welcomed the U.S.-Iran agreement to end the Middle East conflict, which began after a joint U.S.-Israel offensive in February 2026 that killed Iran’s Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei. The Itamararty urged compliance with the memorandum, a complete halt to hostilities, and praised mediation efforts by Pakistan, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey. Brazil reiterated that diplomatic dialogue is the only path to lasting peace in the region, including Palestine.

item.title: Lula sanciona piso salarial para professores da educação básica
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed into law the new minimum salary for basic education teachers at R$ 5,130.63, a 5.4% increase over the previous value and a real gain of 1.5 percentage points above inflation. The legislation, published in the Official Gazette of the Union, changes the annual adjustment formula to use the IPCA and Fundeb revenues, and is projected to cost R$ 6.4 billion in 2026 if adopted by all federal entities.

item.title: “Os dois são iguais”, diz Ciro Gomes sobre Lula e Bolsonaro
item.description: Ciro Gomes claims Lula and Bolsonaro are rigorously identical in economic policies despite aesthetic differences, and argues that supporting the PL in Ceará is not a contradiction due to distinct local political culture. He aims to return as governor of Ceará to combat violence and organized crime, rejecting an alliance with Flávio Bolsonaro but accepting PL state support to emancipate the state from what he calls the PT's tragedy in security, health, and development.

item.title: PT quer reservar valor máximo permitido pelo TSE para campanha de Lula
item.description: The PT plans to use the maximum amount authorized by the TSE for Lula's 2026 campaign, maintaining the 2022 limits: R$ 88.94 million for the first round and R$ 44.44 million for the second, if needed. The party will receive R$ 615 million from the Electoral Fund in 2026, the second-largest share after the PL. A final decision on the spending cap is expected in the coming days, with parties urging the TSE to keep the 2022 levels due to no adjustment in the Special Campaign Financing Fund.

item.title: A multidão desiludida: decepção com a política cresce no país e será decisiva nas eleições
item.description: Political disillusionment is rising in Brazil and will be decisive in the 2026 elections, according to a Fesp-SP survey. 41% of respondents say they vote out of disappointment — up 9 points from 20 years ago — particularly among moderates and 'lesser evil' voters. The failure of governments to address basic issues like health and education fuels this sentiment, which may benefit radical candidates or increase abstention.

item.title: Carta ao Leitor: Largada em alto nível
item.description: VEJA's Rumos do Brasil project launched the 2026 election event cycle with interviews of six candidates at Teatro Santos Augusta in São Paulo. The gathering featured civilized debates on privatization (notably Sabesp), security, corruption, and fiscal management, emphasizing the confrontation between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad. The event was broadcast on TV VEJA+ and attended by 25 media outlets, reinforcing the magazine's commitment to high-level public discourse.

item.title: Vorcaro vai continuar no presídio vip da PF. Saiba o porquê
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro will remain indefinitely in the Federal Police's VIP detention facility in Brasília, the same unit where Jair Bolsonaro was held before being moved to house arrest. The exclusive article, available only to subscribers, states he will not be transferred to a regular prison or released at this time. Full access requires registration via the article's link.

item.title: Enquanto Joesley e Odebrecht financiavam campanha, Vorcaro distribui apartamentos
item.description: Twelve years after the start of Operation Car Wash, banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master has replaced figures like Marcelo Odebrecht and Joesley Batista at the center of Brazil's corruption investigations. The allegations span the political spectrum, targeting senators such as Jaques Wagner (PT), Ciro Nogueira (PP), Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), and congressional leaders Hugo Motta and David Alcolumbre, with claims of luxury apartments, expensive travel, extravagant parties, and multi-million-dollar contracts, some reaching into the judiciary.

item.title: Agência de ex-marqueteiro de Flávio tem vitória na Justiça contra governo de SP
item.description: São Paulo’s judiciary ordered the state government to reinstate Cálix Propaganda, the agency of Flávio Bolsonaro’s former campaign strategist Marcello Lopes, in a R$300 million annual institutional advertising tender after its disqualification over alleged bid rule violations. The ruling is preliminary and provisional, allowing the agency to continue in the process under 'sub judice' status while the full case proceeds. The São Paulo government stated the authorization is conditional on the final judicial outcome.

item.title: STF atropela TSE e tribunais regionais em decisões que podem causar turbulências na corrida eleitoral
item.description: STF justices have been issuing rulings with direct electoral impact, overstepping the authority of the TSE and regional electoral courts, potentially creating legal uncertainty ahead of the October general elections. The interventions come at a critical juncture, raising concerns about judicial overreach and institutional balance.

item.title: Campanha de Lula fica em alerta após ação da PF contra Jaques Wagner
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign is on alert following a Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner, a historic ally of the president. Campaign allies fear the action could damage the government's image and neutralize a key communication strategy: linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Banco Master scandal, which had been used to attack the opposition. While publicly defending due process, insiders acknowledge the operation revives the 'Master ghost' within the PT and may be turned against Lula's campaign by Bolsonaro supporters.

item.title: Zelensky volta a pedir ajuda de Lula para intermediar conversas com Putin
item.description: Zelensky asked Lula to intercede with Putin to resume peace negotiations in the Ukraine war, leveraging Brazil's role as a dialogue channel with Russia. Lula said he had the 'best conversation' with Zelensky, noting the Ukrainian leader showed willingness to seek a ceasefire, agreeing to maintain frequent contact.

item.title: Programas da Suderj e do Procon entram na mira do Governo do Estado por falta de transparência
item.description: Acting Rio Governor Ricardo Couto suspended payments to the Procon-linked Consumer Counter project due to irregularities and lack of transparency in a R$53 million contract. Similar caution was applied to three Suderj NGO agreements after the State Controller’s Office flagged operational similarities with previously suspended Ceperj programs, which led to the conviction of former Governor Cláudio Castro and former Deputy Rodrigo Bacellar by the TSE. The Procon project is also under investigation by the Gaeco of the Rio Public Ministry.

item.title: Flávio vê chance de deixar a defensiva e dividir custo político do caso Master após envolvimento de líder do governo
item.description: The Federal Police operation against Senate government leader Jaques Wagner shifted the political climate around Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who now sees an opportunity to share the political cost of the Banco Master scandal. Previously isolated as the main political figure linked to the Dark Horse film financing controversy, Flávio has begun to go on the offensive, publicly advocating for a CPMI to investigate the bank, though allies admit the move is largely rhetorical due to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s resistance.

item.title: Caso Master chega ao líder do governo no Senado - O Assunto #1743
item.description: The Federal Police launched the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero targeting Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), who is suspected of using his political influence to benefit Banco Master in exchange for undue advantages, including a luxury apartment valued at R$2.5 million and millionaire transfers to relatives' companies. The PF highlights a relationship dating back to 2018 between Wagner and banker Augusto Lima, tied to Bahia’s privatization of a public supermarket chain and the creation of a payroll-deduct credit card for state employees, later adopted by Banco Master. The scandal has intensified pressure within Lula’s government and the PT for Wagner to relinquish his Senate leadership role to shield Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: Irresponsabilidade fiscal de Alcolumbre nada deve à de Lula
item.description: Senate and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) is accused of promoting fiscally irresponsible measures as a show of power against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, putting the country at risk of bankruptcy. The article argues that, beyond alleged fiscal imprudence by the Executive, the Legislature under his leadership is worsening Brazil’s economic crisis with policies that could trigger national financial collapse.

item.title: Crédito do Move Brasil para motoristas de aplicativo será diferente para homens e mulheres. Veja as taxas e as outras condições
item.description: President Lula's Move Brasil program offers BNDES-backed credit lines for ride-hailing and taxi drivers to purchase new flex, hybrid, or electric vehicles up to R$150,000, with a six-month grace period and 72-month repayment. Women receive more favorable terms at 11.5% annual interest versus 12.6% for men. Credit approval is handled by accredited commercial banks, which may reject applicants with negative credit histories despite no explicit ban on defaulters.

item.title: Lula cumpre agenda de investimentos em Minas, estado-chave para as eleições deste ano
item.description: President Lula visits Minas Gerais this Friday to announce investments in health and water infrastructure, including the handover of the Luxembourg Hospital for 100% SUS coverage and the inauguration of the UFSJ University Hospital in Divinópolis. The agenda is part of the federal government's strategy to strengthen its base in the country's second-largest electoral college ahead of the 2026 elections, while the PT has yet to define a candidate for the state government after Rodrigo Pacheco's withdrawal.

item.title: Move Brasil começa hoje: veja a regras e quais bancos vão financiar carros para motoristas de aplicativo e taxistas
item.description: The Move Brasil program launches today, offering reduced-interest car financing for ride-hailing drivers and taxi drivers with approved federal registration. Interest rates are set at 12.6% per year for men and 11.5% for women — below the current Selic rate of 14.25% — funded by R$30 billion from BNDES, with C6 Bank and Santander as participating institutions. Eligibility requires at least 100 trips in one year to prevent non-professionals from exploiting the subsidized credit.

item.title: Caiado diz que caso de Jaques Wagner é “marca forte do PT”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD pre-candidate for president, claimed the suspicions against Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) in the Master case reflect the 'strong mark of the PT,' accusing the party of being complacent with crime and corruption. He said he was not surprised by the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which involved searches in three states and seizure of cash. Wagner denies the allegations, stating the mentioned apartment is not his and that the seized funds are from legitimate official travel allowances.

item.title: PGR pede que Supremo mantenha em vigor lei que reduz pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) urged the Supreme Federal Court to keep in force a law that reduces penalties for those convicted of attempting a coup d'état, which benefits former President Jair Bolsonaro. The PGR argued that suspending the law could create legal uncertainty and undermine the principle of equality.

item.title: Operação contra Wagner reduz chance de indicação de Messias antes das eleições
item.description: The operation targeting the Senate government leader, linked to the Wagner group, significantly reduced the chances of President Lula resubmitting Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF before the 2026 elections. The episode intensified political pressure on the government and raised doubts about the nomination's viability amid growing institutional instability.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio quer cautela em resposta à ação da PF contra líder de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign advocates a cautious response to the Federal Police operation targeting Lula's Senate leader, Jaques Wagner (PT-BA). The directive is to address the incident briefly, without overshadowing the rollout of his presidential pre-candidacy proposals. The goal is to maintain focus on his political agenda, avoiding excessive reactions that could divert voter attention.

item.title: Ação da PF contra Jaques Wagner gera temor no governo e afeta discurso de Lula para campanha
item.description: The Federal Police operation against Jaques Wagner, the government leader in the Senate, caused fear in Lula's inner circle, as it revived the Banco Master scandal and may weaken the Workers' Party's campaign rhetoric against Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 election.

item.title: Betnacional escala seguranças em ação contra “maldição de Rocky Balboa”
item.description: Betnacional deployed six Brazilian security guards to protect the Rocky Balboa statue in Philadelphia, aiming to prevent the 'Rocky Curse' — a superstition that teams honoring the monument suffer defeats in crucial matches. As part of a marketing stunt, the company plans to dress the statue in jerseys from Argentina, France, and Spain to 'transfer' the alleged bad luck ahead of the Brazil vs. Haiti match in the 2026 World Cup qualifiers. The firm, an official sponsor of the 2026 World Cup broadcast on Globo and CazéTV, features ambassadors like Vinicius Jr. and Galvão Bueno and has operated legally in Brazil since January 2025 under fixed-odds betting authorization.

item.title: Influente no PT e amigo de Lula, Wagner se torna alvo fácil para adversários do presidente
item.description: Wagner, an influential figure in the PT and a close associate of Lula, has become an easy target for the president's adversaries due to his visibility and ties to the PT. Despite having less internal power within the party, his association with the PT's old guard exposes him to strategic attacks from the opposition. The text highlights the tension between the PT's new leadership, which is more technical and distant from Lula, and the historical allies who maintain close personal ties to the president.

item.title: A primeira conversa de Lula com Jaques Wagner após operação da PF contra líder do governo
item.description: Lula spoke by phone with Jaques Wagner hours after the PF launched Operation Compliance Zero against the senator, who is the government leader in the Senate. The president avoided going into detail but stressed that Wagner must provide explanations and answer all questions, contrasting with Flávio Bolsonaro’s inadequate handling of his ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. They did not discuss Wagner’s political future, which will be addressed in a meeting next week, with allies expecting him to step down from the leadership post to avoid tainting Lula’s reelection bid.

item.title: Explicação de Jaques Wagner é “inconcebível”, diz Glauber Braga
item.description: Deputy Glauber Braga (Psol-RJ) criticized Senator Jaques Wagner's (PT-BA) explanation regarding R$ 49,000 in cash found at his residence, calling the claim that the money came from dollar-denominated Senate daily allowances 'inconceivable'. Braga suggested the case could be exploited by the far-right to divert attention from other investigations involving government allies. Wagner confirmed negotiating a R$ 2.5 million apartment with Augusto Lima, former partner of Banco Master, to assist his daughter in purchasing the unit under construction in Salvador.

item.title: PGR quer transferir investigação da “Abin Paralela” para a 1ª instância
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office (PGR) has asked the STF to transfer the investigation into the so-called 'Parallel Abin' to the first-instance court, arguing that only Jair Bolsonaro had privileged jurisdiction and that his conduct was already judged in the coup plot case. The remaining facts, according to the PGR, do not directly relate to officials with special jurisdiction or to an antidemocratic purpose. If accepted, the case will be handled by a first-instance judge, affecting investigations involving figures such as Carlos Bolsonaro and Alexandre Ramagem.

item.title: Ministro Kassio Nunes Marques lança obra “O processo e o STF – perspectivas constitucionais”
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, launched the book "The Process and the STF – Constitutional Perspectives" at the Ministro Sepúlveda Pertence Space in Brasília. The work, organized by him and coordinated by Hannah Gevartosky, Marcus Vinicius Kiyoshi Onodera and Pedro Júlio Sales D’Araújo, addresses the nuances of the Brazilian justice system, procedural challenges, and concerns about judicial delays.

item.title: Como a operação contra Jaques Wagner reforça discurso recorrente de Lula
item.description: The Federal Police operation against Jaques Wagner, a close ally of Lula, has caused political wear for the government but provides the president with an opportunity to reinforce his narrative of PF independence. According to political scientist Marco Antônio Teixeira (FGV), the probe strengthens public perception of the PF’s autonomy and impartiality, though Luly risks undermining the defense of his allies by publicly endorsing the investigation’s legitimacy.

item.title: PGR defende aplicar Lei da Dosimetria antes de julgamento pelo STF
item.description: The Attorney General's Office advocated for the application of the Dosimetry Law (Law 15.402/2026) pending the STF's merit ruling, arguing that reducing sentences for January 8 defendants does not constitute amnesty but regulates penalty enforcement. The opinion, signed by PGR Paulo Gonet, dismissed requests from Lula-aligned parties to block the law, stating there is no arbitrariness and that Congress acted within its legislative autonomy.

item.title: Caiado diz que suspeita contra Jaques Wagner é 'marca do PT' e anuncia que irá apresentar propostas de governo só depois da Copa
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD pre-candidate for presidency, accused the PT of being the 'brand' of corruption in Brazil, commenting on suspicions against Senator Jaques Wagner. He also criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's public security plan, stating he will only present his own proposals after the World Cup to avoid competing for voter attention. Caiado emphasized his experience as Goiás governor in fighting crime and promised to compare his security indicators with those of the Lula government.

item.title: Antes de operação da PF, Lula questionou Jaques Wagner sobre Caso Master e ouviu que não havia nada
item.description: Before the PF operation, President Lula questioned Jaques Wagner about the Master Case and was told there was nothing involved. Wagner said the seized dollars were from Senate per diems and that Lula expressed solidarity. Despite their 45-year friendship, government allies are pressuring for Wagner’s removal as Senate leader due to the political risk of the scandal, even without proven wrongdoing.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro critica Nikolas Ferreira em meio a debates sobre o caso Banco Master
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized Deputy Nikolas Ferreira on social media amid congressional debates over the Banco Master case. The mutual accusations between government and opposition reveal strategic divisions within the Brazilian right. The episode underscores personal and ideological tensions among Bolsonarist allies.

item.title: Zema faz campanha no Nordeste após criticar região e diz que proximidade com EUA e Europa é 'potencial turístico'
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president from the Novo Party, campaigned in the Northeast after previous controversies over criticisms of the region. Speaking in Recife, he said he has 'an enormous appreciation for the Northeast' and emphasized proximity to the U.S. and Europe as tourism potential for national growth, claiming his 2023 remarks were misinterpreted.

item.title: PGR se manifesta contra suspensão da Lei da Dosimetria, que pode beneficiar Bolsonaro
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) opposed the suspension of the Dosimetry Law, which allows sentence reductions for those convicted of the January 8, 2023, attacks, stating the law is not unconstitutional merely because it may benefit specific defendants. The law, enacted by Congress after overriding a presidential veto, was suspended by Justice Alexandre de Moraes pending a final Supreme Court ruling. The AGU had previously argued the law is unconstitutional, asserting that attacks on democracy require a firm response.

item.title: PGR pede que Moraes envie à primeira instância fatos remanescentes da investigação da Abin Paralela
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged Minister Alexandre de Moraes to remit the remaining facts of the 'Abin Paralela' investigation to the lower court, stating that the portions concerning former President Jair Bolsonaro and the alleged institutional rupture project have already been fully examined by the Supreme Court. The outstanding episodes mainly involve public administration crimes and do not justify keeping the case at the STF, as they lack direct ties to Bolsonaro’s privileged status or the antidemocratic purpose that originally warranted the Court’s intervention.

item.title: EUA classificam condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro como “perseguição”
item.description: The U.S. State Department labeled Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction by Brazil's STF as 'persecution' and 'lawfare', claiming political use of the judiciary against opponents. The unanimous conviction by the STF's 1st Chamber was for coercion in the course of proceedings, after Eduardo sought to pressure U.S. authorities to impose sanctions on Brazilian judiciary officials to benefit his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Trump mistakenly referred to Eduardo as his brother Flávio and falsely claimed he had been arrested, despite Eduardo being in self-exile in the U.S.

item.title: Caso Master: Planalto desaprova estratégia usada por Wagner de tentar usar Lula como escudo na crise
item.description: The Plano Palácio rejected Senator Jaques Wagner’s (PT-BA) strategy of using President Lula as a shield against allegations tied to the Banco Master scheme, calling it unsustainable. Lula’s aides said Wagner may be sacrificed to protect the president’s image ahead of the 2026 elections, despite their 40-year friendship. Wagner is under investigation in Operation Compliance Zero for allegedly receiving a R$2.5 million property and bribe payments via a company linked to his daughter-in-law, which he denies.

item.title: PGR se manifesta contra suspensão da Lei da Dosimetria e sinaliza validade da norma
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet opposed the request to temporarily suspend the Dosimetry Law (Law 15.402/2026), indicating the PGR will likely defend its constitutionality on the merits. The law, enacted after Congress overrode President Lula’s veto, reduces penalties for multiple crimes against the democratic state committed in the same context—such as the January 8 attacks—benefiting defendants like Jair Bolsonaro. Although Justice Alexandre de Moraes suspended its application in the January 8 cases, the law remains valid pending the Supreme Court’s final ruling.

item.title: Jamanta desgovernada, caso Master gera estrago ao governo Lula; veja vídeo
item.description: The 'ungoverned manta' — a leak of messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone and allies — hit the Lula government, involving Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) in a controversy that caused political damage. The Master case, tied to alleged irregularities, is being weaponized by opponents to undermine the PT administration ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Gonet defende lei que pode reduzir pena de Bolsonaro e diz ao STF que Congresso tem autonomia
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet defended the validity of the Dosimetry Law, despite Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes suspending its application in concrete cases until the full court rules on the matter. Gonet argued that Congress has autonomy to legislate on the issue, reinforcing the separation of powers. The statement was made on June 18, 2026.

item.title: 'Abin paralela': PGR defende que investigação saia do STF e vá para a primeira instância
item.description: The PGR argues that the 'Abin paralela' investigation should be moved from the STF to the first instance, stating that only Jair Bolsonaro had privileged jurisdiction and his conduct was already assessed in the coup plot case. Other suspects, including Carlos Bolsonaro and Alexandre Ramagem, should be tried by lower court judges, as the remaining facts pertain to administrative misconduct not directly tied to the authority with special forum.

item.title: PGR pede a Moraes para enviar inquérito da Abin paralela de Bolsonaro à primeira instância
item.description: The Attorney General's Office requested that Justice Alexandre de Moraes of the Supreme Federal Court send the 'parallel Abin' investigation to the first instance, as the facts no longer involve privileged jurisdiction. The PGR states that the pending investigations concern offenses against public administration, such as violation of functional duties, and do not justify the Supreme Court's intervention.
